title: Research: solver-free P111 copied-rank certificate and source-order correction
head: e2ec7d7e719031e8f8b8012a4ab5b20faed074ce
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add a solver-free algebraic proof that the fixed label-functional copied-rank optimum is **63** for the actual bit P111 fixtures from #545 and #555. The model allows asymmetric factors, repeated terms and any finite number of totals: nine terms cost at least 63, ten at least 64, and eleven or more at least 66. Literal nine-term witnesses attain 63.

**Credit #620 (Joel Pulikkan / GamingPuzzled) for the previously reported value and SAT obstruction.** This contribution supplies an independent algebraic argument and exact source binding, not priority for the number 63. The archived sorted Hamming-root order differs from the published supplier order, so the same numeric deletion list selects a different puncture. The complete permutation and a rejection control are included; the corrected checks establish 63 on both actual published fixtures.

Only `research/p111-copy-rank-certificate/` is added. **No new kappa or global novelty is claimed.** The result concerns this fixed binary label-functional factorization model, priced by rational pairing rank under the inherited #446 premise. Arbitrary port-subset rectangles, other decoder matrices, vector-valued labels, physical supplier realization, frames, restoration, hosting and the full multiplication theorem remain outside scope. The selected construction and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. The pre-submission refresh inspected all-state P111 search results and recently updated PRs through #748. #717's complex decoders, #738's Gaussian geometry, #747's global stars and #748's source-representation circuit have different scopes. Exact references, predecessor attribution, the seed-41 structural-decoder assignment and the bounded fork-and-flush run are recorded in the package. Prepared for Russell Seligmann (@rseligm2) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.

## Validation

From the repository root, using Python 3.9+ and only the standard library:

```sh
python3 -B research/p111-copy-rank-certificate/verify.py --check research/p111-copy-rank-certificate/RESULTS.json
```

Expected: `PASS_P111_COPY_RANK: optimum 63 on two fixtures; exact geometry, independent minors, 18 negative controls`.

- Exact checks cover all 511 nonzero supports per fixture, all 100 span-class pairs, all 12,321 live decoder entries, both witnesses, independent rank-three minor obstructions and 18 negative controls. Exhaustive three-dimensional projection controls support the mechanism; the all-length conclusion comes from the written proof.
- Python 3.9.6 and optimized Python 3.13.14 pass with byte-identical regenerated receipts. Clean relocated patch replay, source-byte and receipt-tamper rejection, selected-record integrity, local links and staged whitespace pass.
- Three fresh Astra/max branches and subsequent separate AI reviews checked the proof, source binding and independent finite obstructions. The initial archived-order inputs were corrected and re-evaluated; that distinction is explicit in `METHOD.md`.

The repository-wide `make verify`, full selected-supplier cold replay and proof-assistant verification were not run. Local exact checks are not formal verification of the full multiplication theorem. Hosted CI has not executed: all five upstream workflows report `action_required` with zero check jobs, requiring maintainer approval. The [Verify research artifacts run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38349993369) is pinned to the submitted head `e2ec7d7e719031e8f8b8012a4ab5b20faed074ce`. No hosted CI pass is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
